about: The real rust-analyzer, found past rustup's proxy in the toolchains the Mac has: opening src/lib.rs of a Cargo project in the Code layout starts it, and resting on x shows the server's own hover card. HOME is the journey's folder under target/; only RUSTUP_HOME points at the installed toolchains, read and never written.

project.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "journey"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

# Its own workspace: the journey's folder sits under this repository's.
[workspace]
